title: Transmission line power loss
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the power loss on the transmission line using the line current and resistance.

title: Generator coil resistance
description: Essential: Correctly solves for the internal resistance of the generator coil using circuit analysis.

title: External work per cycle
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the work done by the external force over one full rotation of the coil.

title: Transformer power and current analysis
description: Important: Correctly applies transformer ratios and power conservation to find currents and voltages in the transmission system.

title: Peak and RMS EMF
description: Important: Correctly calculates the peak induced EMF and its RMS value for the AC generator.

title: User load power analysis
description: Important: Correctly determines the current drawn by the operating motor from its power rating.

title: Energy conservation application
description: Optional: Explicitly states or uses energy conservation (input power = useful power + losses) in the setup.

title: Sign or ratio inversion error
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly applies transformer voltage or current ratios (e.g., inverts n1/n2 or n3/n4).

title: RMS vs. peak value confusion
description: Pitfall: Uses peak EMF where RMS is required, or vice versa, in power or voltage calculations.
